items.title: Marsh becomes first international broker to offer captive management in Bahrain
items.summary: The expansion builds on Marsh's existing Gulf operations in Dubai and Abu Dhabi as regional corporate demand for captive insurance accelerates.

items.title: Former marine insurance claims handler jailed for fraud totalling nearly $4 million
items.summary: Rajit Sharma was sentenced to seven and a half years at Southwark Crown Court after diverting insurance claim payments over a seven-year period.

items.title: John Lewis Money appoints ex-Co-op Insurance MD to lead broker push
items.summary: John Lewis Money has hired the former managing director of Co-op Insurance to head up its new broker push.

items.title: Irish MGAs face 2027 growth pressure amid competition
items.summary: Managing general agents in Ireland are navigating margin compression and insurer appetite while targeting sustainable growth for 2027.

items.title: Aviva splits commercial leadership role as Michelle Taylor is promoted to chief distribution officer
items.summary: Aviva has elevated its broker relationships to a standalone C-suite position following the departure of Dave Martin.

items.title: UK property insurance claims hit record £10,000 average as subsidence surges
items.summary: The average home and business insurance claim reached a record £10,000 in the third quarter of 2026, driven by record-breaking summer heat and subsidence claims.
